TOOLING BURST FL-3 — fire lane round 3: the anti-decal round (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt 2026-09-16 on the Mac: the fire "seems very much like a decal" — F-C5-29; conductor R-C5-99). task_id "FL-3".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a (material), T4h (burst_v2, key states), FL-2, FL-2c and the new row "FL-3 — anti-decal round (additive core · interior boil · contact light · heat shimmer)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/vfx_material.gdshader (palette bands, erode/dissolve, erode_noise + noise texture, dark_duplicate), export/godot_import.py (the burst_v2 pieces phase: expanded/spent key-state holds; Glow/Flash/DarkDuplicate layers; the victim_tint on contact; the FL-2 peak halo/embers; _g1_config; the legacy authored picker path), export/effect_kit.py (layer + pieces validation), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (+ _A), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART 0 — ALIGNMENTS FIRST (conductor, outside suite after FL-2c): (0a) BurnBackExportTests.test_screen_px_picker_g1_and_socket_contract → KeyError 'root' in _g1_config for a synthetic kit without a root key — make _g1_config robust (a legacy/synthetic kit without root must not crash; capsule length falls back to the head primitive's pivot/rear-socket distance or the default 1.2 BH) and keep the test's assertions; (0b) AuthoredEffectPickerTests.test_headless_authored_cast_east_north_collision_timing_and_feedback_cleanup times out at 60 s since FL-2c — diagnose (a degenerate capsule for a legacy authored head without rear/tip metadata? the probe waiting on an event the capsule path no longer emits?) and fix the runtime if it hangs; never weaken the probe; (0c) FireLaneHeadlessTests.test_eight_direction_release_rear_and_body_clearance — the head_centre_in_body clause fails for five early S ticks by construction of the capsule at the south pose; re-encode the clause as "no contact with the caster's own body and the capsule rear at the release socket" (the intent), documented in the docstring. (0d) BoltChainEmissionTests.test_current_catalogue_and_original_kits_unchanged stays red (T4x kits, E3-r1) — name it.

THE ROUND — what makes a painted burst stop reading as a sticker on a desktop screen is motion inside the body and light outside it. Five moves, kit fields under `layers` / `pieces`, all validated with ranges, defaults OFF so the 14 other kits stay byte-identical:
PART 1 — ADDITIVE CORE: a second draw of the burst body restricted to palette band 3 (the cream flare) as ADD with a 6-px soft blur and α .55, present from contact through the expanded hold, fading with the residue (`layers.core {band 3, alpha .55, blur_px 6}`). Trace clause: a Core node exists with additive material; α samples at contact / expanded / spent.
PART 2 — INTERIOR BOIL: during the expanded (4 f) and spent (6 f) key-state holds, drift the erosion-noise UV at 0.35 texture-widths/s along the flare's up axis and oscillate `erode` ±0.06 at 6 Hz (`pieces.boil {uv_per_s .35, erode_amp .06, hz 6}`); cap the expanded hold at 3 f (`key_states[expanded].hold_frames 3`). Trace clause: shader uniforms change on every hold frame; no two consecutive hold frames identical.
PART 3 — CONTACT LIGHT ON THE STRUCK BODY: on contact the struck target's sprite modulates toward palette band 2 (lerp .45) for 6 frames easing out, and its dark duplicate (if any) offsets +4 px away from the impact (`layers.contact_light {lerp .45, frames 6}`) — composes with the existing victim_tint (report how they stack; victim_tint keeps priority). Trace clause: modulate samples at ages +1/+3/+6 on the shield dummy after an east cast.
PART 4 — HEAT SHIMMER on the residue: a screen-space distortion quad over the residue (a small ShaderMaterial with a 2-octave noise UV offset, amplitude 3 px, 0.8 s, α fading with the residue) (`layers.shimmer {amplitude_px 3, seconds .8}`); gl_compatibility-safe (no SCREEN_TEXTURE dependency that breaks the web build — use a BackBufferCopy only if compat-safe; otherwise a subtle additive noise sheet and SAY SO).
PART 5 — PEAK SIZE CHECK (report only): the impact flare is 4.0 BH by spec; at 1080p next to a 1.16-BH dummy it reads very large (Matt accepted the size on the phone). Report the flare's measured extent in the east-cast trace; no change.

Apply the new fields to runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (provenance "R-C5-99 FL-3") and the three fire kits' kit.json (fire_bolt_e1_A/_B, fire_burst_e0p_v2); primitives byte-identical.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-3/acceptance.json): Part 0 diagnoses/fixes with traces; Parts 1–4 trace clauses with numbers; Part 5 report; 14 kits byte-identical; full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 for BOTH renderers (gl_compatibility is the shipping one — the web build); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line; byte locks re-baselined only with the FL-1b diff rule.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): field validations; the trace clauses; Part 0 realignments; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except the three fire kits' kit.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-3/ and runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (named fields); fixtures/ only for byte-lock re-baselines with diffs. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Do not delete anything outside runs/C-5/t3/FL-3/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-3"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
